conflictSummary_one: {{count}} action has a conflicting shortcut. It may not work as expected.
conflictSummary_other: {{count}} actions have conflicting shortcuts. They may not work as expected.

conflicts.prefix: {{keys}} overlaps {{otherKeys}} of “{{other}}”: one starts with the other.
conflicts.shadow: {{keys}} is also used by “{{other}}” ({{scope}}). Where both apply, the more specific one wins.
conflicts.reserved: {{keys}} is usually taken by the browser or the system and may not reach Aphel.

scopes.globalDescription: Work on any screen, except while you type in a field.
scopes.editorDescription: Work inside the message, note and assistant text boxes.

actions.palette: Open or close the command palette

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.description: Single-key shortcuts do not work while you type in a field.
help.disabled: Shortcuts are turned off in your preferences. {{keys}} still works.

recorder.title: Shortcut for “{{action}}”
recorder.description: Press the key combination you want to use.
recorder.label: New combination
recorder.hint: Click here and press the keys. For a sequence, such as G then D, press both one after the other.
recorder.appendHint: The new combination becomes an alternative instead of replacing the current one.
recorder.replaceHint: Saving removes the combination from the other action.

user.title: Keyboard shortcuts
user.description: Customize shortcuts just for you. Anything you leave unchanged follows the company default.
user.enabledHint: When off, only {{keys}} (command palette) and the shortcuts inside editors keep working.

organization.title: Company keyboard shortcuts
organization.description: Set everyone's default shortcuts, such as the register keys on every terminal. Each person can still change their own.
